concerns.text: FR-004 and Constitution Principle VII mandate the 'original FastContext (4B model)' as the baseline. Task T021a implements a '1.5B distilled' baseline instead. No task exists to implement or run the required 4B baseline, leaving FR-004 and SC-002/SC-003 unfulfillable.

Constitution Principle VI requires all comparative evaluations to be stratified (Regular vs Irregular). T021a and the plan's risk mitigation limit the baseline run to the 'Regular' set only. No task exists to run the baseline on the 'Irregular' set, making FR-006 (degradation on Irregular set) impossible to calculate.

FR-005 requires 'continuous regression analysis correlating regularity score with performance delta' across the full spectrum to identify boundaries. T028b restricts this correlation to the 'Regular' set only. No task exists to perform the regression on the full dataset or the 'Irregular' set as required.

SC-004 defines a specific quantitative threshold (10% precision drop) to confirm boundary conditions. T029 only calculates the degradation percentage. No task exists to compare this result against the 10% threshold or flag the condition, leaving SC-004 unverified.

FR-001 requires ground-truth validation sourced from SWE-bench annotations. T007b (Annotation Extractor) is marked as a prerequisite for T011 and T019, but the task description is truncated/incomplete ('...for validation (FR-001)'). Without a complete implementation of T007b, the ground-truth validation required by FR-001 cannot be performed.

Task T027 cites a Wikipedia URL for power analysis logic. Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires citations to be verified against primary sources. While this is a citation quality issue, it also implies the task description lacks a valid, verifiable reference for the statistical methodology required by FR-005.
